GEN.name: Generator
GEN.unit: one large generator or a pallet of small ones, about 100 kW with 48 hours of fuel
GEN.wantedFor: hospital, clean rooms, shelters, pumps, reefer plugs, the dam's controls

FUEL.name: Fuel
FUEL.unit: one tanker load, 5,000 gallons of diesel
FUEL.wantedFor: every generator, every boat, every ambulance after the first day

BOAT.name: Boat
BOAT.wantedFor: rescue from Southfield, Riverside, the terminal; the search for the Harvester

LIFT.name: Lift
LIFT.unit: one sortie: a plane load (45 seats, Gateway, before T-30h) or a helicopter load (6 seats, Sterling, before T-24h or in the eye)

SHELTER.name: Shelter
SHELTER.unit: 500 hardened places with water and sanitation for 72 hours
SHELTER.wantedFor: families from the surge zone, Southfield, Riverside, the Strand's visitors

MEDIC.name: Medical team
MEDIC.unit: one medical team with a vehicle
MEDIC.wantedFor: Heartland has none; the terminal and the Mole have crowds

COLD.name: Cold bay
COLD.unit: one pharmaceutical-grade cold bay with its own backup power
COLD.wantedFor: the blood bank, insulin, vaccines; or 24,000 doses

CREW.name: Crew
CREW.unit: twenty trained people with a truck or heavy equipment
CREW.wantedFor: clearing roads, sandbagging, moving the ICU by hand, the Southfield convoy

FUND.name: Fund
FUND.unit: a $5M line for hazard pay, relief or rebuilding, released by the crisis room

COMMS.name: Uplink
COMMS.unit: an hour a day of uplink and a satellite phone, lent to one parish
COMMS.wantedFor: a parish with no other way to be heard

WATER.name: Water tanker
WATER.wantedFor: a parish whose mains have failed

haven.note: The terminal holds 640,000 gallons, not the 500,000 it reports.

sterling.note: Twenty small generators in the executive garages, on no island inventory.

ROUND.description: Preparation allocation: each table writes KEEP or SEND and a parish for every token. Only entries count; sends are final; a kept token can be asked for by mayday.
